name: llm-source-auto
label: LLM source
description: This machine has an LLM source to fund agent calls (`flow llm set auto`).

commands.darwin: f=$(command -v flow || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/flow"); "$f" llm set auto
commands.linux: f=$(command -v flow || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/flow"); "$f" llm set auto
commands.win32: $f = (Get-Command flow -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $f) { $f = "$HOME\.local\bin\flow.exe" }; & $f llm set auto; exit $LASTEXITCODE

commands.darwin: f=$(command -v flow || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/flow"); "$f" llm set auto --no-browser >/dev/null 2>&1
commands.linux: f=$(command -v flow || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/flow"); "$f" llm set auto --no-browser >/dev/null 2>&1
commands.win32: $f = (Get-Command flow -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $f) { $f = "$HOME\.local\bin\flow.exe" }; & $f llm set auto --no-browser *> $null; exit $LASTEXITCODE
